title: SEKA ExAero GR Unboxing: My 2027 Gravel Race Bike

takeaways.text: The presenter waited about six months; in the US the frame was stocked by a single dealer at the time (October 2026).

Needs an outboard-bearing T47 bottom bracket; the box includes down-tube storage bag, bottom-bracket, down-tube and chainstay protectors, UDH hanger, a front-derailleur mount option and a titanium top-cap bolt.
SEKA's figures cited here: 56 mm front and 52 mm rear; fitting a front derailleur may reduce usable tire size.
The size-58 frame weighed 1.22 kg as unboxed, the zero-offset seatpost 185.5 g and the Gladius GR bar (110 mm stem, 38 cm) 425 g.

disclosure: US SEKA dealer Power Meter City sent the frameset, and the presenter promotes the dealer in the video.
summary: Unboxing and weigh-in of a size-58 SEKA ExAero GR frameset bought for a 2027 gravel race season.
